messages:
zoe.marketing: Quick plan: 10-day mini launch for a tiny OSS refapp + three snack tutorials. Main goals: stars, forks, and a clear benchmark to cite.

sam.devrel: Agree. Tutorials: quickstart (10m), latency tweaks (12m), add-a-model (15m). Include copy-paste snippets.

eli.eng: I'll run a short perf harness on g6 (fp16 vs int4) and publish CSV. ETA 24h.

ana.content: I'll draft the launch post and two tweet threads (announce + technical). Need bench numbers and a one-line engineer quote.

mike.growth: Routing: gated download + flows: enterprise->SDR, maintainers->devrel nurture, others->marketing drip. We'll tune thresholds after 100 signups.

zoe.marketing: Messaging variants to A/B test: A) "Refapp Mini: ship LLM features faster" B) "Bench-backed starter for predictable inference". Lock timeline tomorrow.

sam.devrel: Adding CONTRIBUTING.md and a reproducible notebook to the repo so folks can validate numbers locally.

eli.eng: Bench done briefly: g6 int4 batch1 seq128 ~2.0x tokens/sec vs fp16. Uploading artifacts now.

ana.content: Got artifacts. Draft post will call out exact model, seq len, batch, and repro link. Tone: developer-first, transparent.

mike.growth: Action items: eli -> artifacts (24h), sam -> tutorials (5d), ana -> post + social drafts (48h), mike -> landing + routing (48h). Sync in 24h. :rocket:
